notes:
Patch 0.1.11

This is a full Windows build. Get it from the website Download button. The game will not quit itself to install this.

World
- Daytime animals are half as many as in 0.1.10. Night stays on its thinner scale.
- Grass, bushes, and rocks are about three times as thick as 0.1.10. A forest chunk aims for 42 trees (0.1.10 aimed for 20).
- Plain stone is the common rock. Copper is about a quarter as common as stone. Iron is rarer. Gold and skyiron are scarce, and an ore vein stays a small cluster.

Creatures
- A creature that is far from you and outside the game camera stops running its scripts until it is near or on screen.

Water
- The blue underwater tint stays off until the camera is under the surface.
- On dry ground the water script no longer searches every object in the world. That search was stalling the frame.

Look
- Fog and clouds are drawn on a coarse grid and laid over a full-resolution picture. Trees stay sharp. The softness is the fog.
